mcp_tools.name: zero_trust_architecture_design_pack
mcp_tools.title: Zero trust architecture design pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a zero-trust architecture design record (identity and perimeter framing declarations, declared asset rows, declared policy rows, segmentation declarations, device and workload trust declarations, monitoring, audit and response declarations, migration and rollout declarations, red lines) and returns a deterministic ZERO_TRUST_DESIGN_SOUND / ZERO_TRUST_DESIGN_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed policy-coverage recomputation over the declared asset and policy rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared design record only; it evaluates no live posture, probes no network and certifies no security outcome.

inputSchema.description: The zero trust architecture design pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).
